context_for_next_testing_agent: Live POST, three recommendation fields, persistence, history reopen, clean new form, JPEG preview, 390px icon-only navigation, and browser console/error scan passed. Remaining coverage is strict server-side image validation and cleanup of TEST_ records.
rca of the issue: Iteration 1's deterministic exclude-set TypeError is fixed. The current remaining concern is that generate_advice accepts any payload string whenever image_mime is an allowed MIME, without decoding or checking actual image content.
